mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Physical rule (section-1): pure-phys thrown attack -> element-neutral, identity expressed via geometry + bleed substrate; conversion is NOT the build's point, so no ELEMENT_CONVERSION_PHYSICAL door. GEOMETRY JUDGMENT (section-7.2): the R-M6 drift-tick-orb class (-> circle) was CONSIDERED and rejected — helix is a FAST attack projectile dealing discrete weapon hits along its path, not a slow-drift tick-AoE orb; the outward TRAVEL is the dominant axis -> line (b04 freezing-pulse / glacial-cascade corridor precedent), with the corkscrew micro-motion, ~4.25-rotation count, and multi-hit-per-enemy-per-pass carried as behavioral notes; alternative (circle) recorded here per the competing-rows law. Bleed attested only as build-level scaling pairing (dossier: 'paired with high physical damage weapon and impale/bleed scaling'; probe control empty) — included as the physical-rule identity ailment with that provenance caveat. Impale has no ailment lane (nearest register: section-2 on-hit sunder window) — trait-lane note, not asserted on the skill. TEMPORAL_CHARGE = the frenzy-charge Raider chassis door; no second door forced (R-M1: doors express the source identity, not everything plausible). Era 3.14-3.19 + 3.20+.
